steps.text: 10:20 A.M. \ Overcast
527km out from Londinium, operation platform of an abandoned mine

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Docking complete.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Nothing out of the ordinary... Phew. Maybe you should take a break now?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Or are you going to start...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Quiet.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Dame Kal'tsit, it's been a while...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: T-Th-This rotten smell...

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: A Vampire. In a doctor's gown too... How strange.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: *Hiss*...

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Retract your fangs.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Not even the oldest red eyes dare to approach my flesh. They are cowards all, and fear my seething anger could cause their fangs to rot.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Kal'tsit, how many Sarkaz are there who could cause me to lose my composure, even for a moment?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There's at least one, right in front of you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's been a long time since I last saw an old Sarkaz hero walking Terra. I presume there must be a reason that you are gracing these barrenlands with your presence, King of the Nachzehrer?

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: You could say I'm here to visit an old friend.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We've met twice.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: You looked very different the first time.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: As for the second time...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I saw someone outside the ship on the day of her accident... So that was really you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I thought the Nachzehrer Court had already made its choice when it turned a blind eye to an assassination that despicable.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Be it then or now, the nachzehrer have only ever had one choice. We are Sarkaz, and we are loyal to the Sarkaz, not the throne or the crown, much less ancient witchcraft.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: For the past few centuries, I have feasted on the flesh and blood of countless enemies, and I have witnessed the fall of several Sarkaz heroes.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Some of them died by the blades of their strongest foes, while others were assassinated.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: As such, I am here because I seek an answer.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Tell me—

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: What killed the last pure-blooded Wendigo?

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Answer me, Dame!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Kal'tsit! H-Hu-Hurry up and get Mon3tr out! He's going to strike!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: The landship is right there! We can't just...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hear me, Nachzehrer King.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will not fight you here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee has departed the cage that had confined him for his entire life. I will not tarnish his last wish with pointless violence.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Is this your way of commemorating a Sarkaz hero? By running away... so loathsomely?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am not running away.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I gave you the answer you wanted, just like when the Wendigo wanted a fight in place of answers.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will say it again, Nachzehrer King. I refuse to fight you here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You feed on the flesh of your enemies and swallow their cries and regrets to fuel your next battle.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yet we are not enemies. There were times when we fought alongside each other, and there were also times when we had to raise swords against each other over differing opinions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Likewise, this applies to Rhodes Island and Buldrokkas'tee when he sided with Reunion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Just as you witnessed her passing, I witnessed the return of a Wendigo soul to Kazdel.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: You say you are his witness.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: And he chose you himself?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In his final moments... Buldrokkas'tee wanted a fitting opponent, and a friend to talk to.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Hah... hahahaha!

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Very well. I accept your answer.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Now, you show yourself, Confessarius.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Had I moved to strike... even if the black monster did not come out, you would have raised your blade against me.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Even I would have to dodge the blade of a Confessarius... That is, if you CAN unsheathe your blade.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You know...

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: I've known your kind for centuries.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: On the contrary, I am surprised that you joined the side of that outblood successor.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Can you carry the burden of your disobedience?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It doesn't matter whether I can or cannot. Since the moment I was born, I have carried these sins.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Exactly! You fascinate me more than the masked one in Londinium!

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: And the Great Banshee, the young one. Is he not here?

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: He is young in years, but his mother taught him well. If he were here, your odds would be a fair bit higher.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your anger has quelled, Nachzehrer King.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: That does not mean I do not wish to kill you.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Let me ask you. Is this ship built atop the remnants of a colossal artifact still the field base of the Sarkaz King-in-exile?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We never once called ourselves that... not even when she was still alive.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: You still won't admit it, even though the outblood successor has now led her forces to Londinium?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya knows her role.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We don't want a war to break out before our eyes. There should be no more needless sacrifices... Both Victorians and Sarkaz have shed more than enough blood already.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Poppycock! A hapless child who dares not call herself King presumes to save the Sarkaz!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I would never presume to persuade the king of a Sarkaz court.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: At least you know your place, then. It takes far more than your debate skills to win the approval of the courts.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: The outblood successor will face a challenge in that iron fortress unlike any before.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is that why you allowed Amiya into Londinium?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The nachzehrer take their nutrients from war. Failure brings nothing but unproductive decay.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It seems you still have your doubts about whether the Military Commission's resolution will truly bring victory to the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Nonsense!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Alerted growl)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Not now, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Nachzehrer King, I'm not doubting the leadership of the Sarkaz army. Just as you said, I'm here to talk to you as an old friend.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Thanks to the Victorian dukes, Londinium is now an impenetrable fortress, yet Theresis is still able to summon the kings to the city.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This tells us that you and your army are guarding the passages into Londinium, yet you did not stop our infiltration.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You had the opportunity to kill me and destroy Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But you didn't.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And that's because of... Amiya.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Heh...

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: How would I know whether it is rebirth or destruction she will wreak unless I get to see her wear that black crown with my own eyes?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You will.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She will surpass what you... no, what any of us could ever imagine.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: Let's put an end to our friendly conversation.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: An eternally young dame, a free-willed vampire, and... a Confessarius who left her kind.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Elder
steps.text: We shall meet again in Londinium.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Phew... He's gone, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Truth be told, that really got my blood pumping. I've lived for a few centuries now, but there are still a lot of things I haven't finished.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: In his eyes... the real battlefield lies elsewhere.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: That's the only reason he let Rhodes Island be.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And I was just saying I don't want to go back to Kazdel... Even if I don't go looking for trouble, trouble's knocking on my door!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Kal'tsit, we can't let something like this happen again. Otherwise, I'm not sure I can guarantee Rhodes Island's safety. We could be in trouble the second you two leave the ship.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's time for us to depart.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Shining, what's your decision?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Doctor... Liz and I are ready. We can leave at a moment's notice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I noticed that you did not deny the Nachzehrer King's accusations.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: There is no point... in denying it.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: For the past three years, life aboard Rhodes Island has been peaceful. Neither Liz nor I could have asked for more.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is it time to say our goodbyes, then?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Doctor, you know very well that if we continue our journey together, both you and Amiya will be in much more danger.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: However... if Rhodes Island needs us, we will remain.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Sir, Defensive Cannon S-309 has been activated—

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Looks like Manfred has made some progress.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Should we report this to the Regent?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: No need. All of this is according to His Majesty's plans.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Manfred still needs more concrete achievements if he is trying to earn the Court's trust. Capturing some fighters is far from enough.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Activating the secondary cannons is the first step. Tell him that His Majesty needs not one, or even several unimportant plates.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Should it be necessary, we can abandon even an entire district...

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Stay still.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: The enemy? Here?!

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Stay still, if you want to keep your head.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: What an unexpected guest.
You don't seem very surprised.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Hmm... Let me put it another way. We've been waiting for your arrival.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: The ship is stopped somewhere in the barrenlands outside Londinium, and I thought you would only have just made it to the walls.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Nonetheless, this is hardly surprising. Assassins are always on the move, no?
You talk too much.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I have you to thank for giving me the opportunity, then.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: If you want to kill me, why not just do it? Your control of the shadow is so masterful that not even I could notice you immediately. And your breathing...

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: It seems you did not neglect the techniques you learned from His Majesty after leaving his side. He will be happy to know that.
Shut up.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Letting your emotions get the better of you is unbecoming of an assassin.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: How nimble.
You're tougher than the others. Sure enough.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Is that why you didn't strike first?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: The life of a Confessarius is not worth taking if it means trading your own... I see. You have yet to see His Majesty, since you've entered the city.
The shadow shows no sign of change. It does not move, much less answer.
The Confessarius gazes past the swath of emptiness to the window and beyond. There is nothing but another swath of emptiness there.
A golden ray of light flutters from his motionless hand toward the faint sunlight outside the window.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: When you reach the throne... you might meet much more than just His Majesty.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I look forward to seeing the look on your face, Ascalon.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: So they have arrived.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Yes, Your Majesty. Our leader has already met one of them in the legislature.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Inform Manfred. We must find out who is among them.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: The young general should have already met with our Messenger, but...

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: He can handle this matter.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: We understand your trust in Manfred, Your Majesty.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: But I must emphasize that he is busy dealing with the rebels on all sides. Judging by the results, it seems he did not immediately detect Rhodes Island's approach.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Tell me the candidates.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: The kings have shown keen interest in that fake for some time now. Aside from the two who have already begun their moves, the Sanguinarch has also grown tired of superfluous social engagements with the city's nobles.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: He is happy to head to Sudean, to Manfred's aid.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Remind him.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: That should he ever find the 'The Sarkaz King' and {@nickname}, bring them to me at once.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: What of the Dame? Of course, the Nachzehrer King will keep an eye on her, but we must be prepared too.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Let the vampires deal with her as they see fit.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Very well, Your Majesty. I'm sure the Prince of Blood will be elated.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: On another note, our leader would like to know if you would have us arrange more guards to secure your surroundings?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: No need. If anyone wishes to call on me, let them come.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: There is one more thing... Suppose 'she' wants to meet with that group, should we interfere?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Let her go.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: In that case, what if 'she' meets her old friends from Rhodes Island...? Will that be a risk?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: You'll remind me now that the witchcraft of the Confessarii is unreliable?

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: My apologies. Please do not be angered.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Just as you saw, 'her' ideas and actions represent the Sarkaz will. This will... should be more than capable of defeating any lingering emotions from the past.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Yet the Confessarii exist to extinguish any lurking problems. Our leader must consider all possibilities.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: A puppet locked inside a cage cannot lead the Sarkaz on the battlefield.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Tell the Confessarii that I will say this only once.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Do not ever insult Theresa again with these excuses... and do not ever insult me again.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We should be nearly there.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Got a signal...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What does it mean... Huh? An emergency meeting?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Was there some kind of emergency?! Rockrock, we have to get back!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: What about them?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The commander's order is to bring them to this position, but she wouldn't have time to see them now.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Leave them here.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: That's a bit of a waste of time, isn't it? How about this? I will bring them to the commander...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We still can't be sure these outsiders are the ones we're looking for.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Who else could they be?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: That's for the commander and the captains to decide.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: You've already taken a big risk by bringing them into the tunnel without permission and leading them this far.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I've already tested them...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: You're quite smart, I'll admit, but you trust others too easily.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Take a closer look at your new friends. Especially the one who's also into drones.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? Who? Me?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: She's... a Sarkaz.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yeah, I'm a Sarkaz, what's the matter? Well, I am not the only Sarkaz here, there...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hmm, huh? A-Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right, Miss Rockrock. They are Sarkaz, and they are also our trusted friends.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We are not like the Sarkaz who took over your home up there.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Whether they're the same is not for you to decide.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What's that supposed to mean?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You should've told us sooner you weren't keen on working with us. We wouldn't have squirmed around in these dark tunnels for so long!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: You're locals. If you want to stay, I will welcome you like I welcome all my brothers in arms.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: ...but I can't trust them so easily.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Ugh... It doesn't matter what you say.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We live together. We die together.

options: We are all Rhodes Island Operators.
All of them are equally trustworthy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's just as the Doctor said...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss Rockrock... We've already exchanged plenty of intelligence.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If you still won't afford us the most basic trust, I don't think we should force ourselves to keep walking this tunnel together.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Feist, on behalf of Rhodes Island, thank you for assisting us earlier.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We will leave you and find our own way out.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Erm, that's not what Rockrock meant.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know. I can see where Miss Rockrock is coming from and how she feels. Resentment always has a root cause, and I definitely won't blame her for this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island has faced similar problems, both before and now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Whether the suspicion and distrust arose because we are Infected or because we stand with the Sarkaz, it's all one and the same to us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We will prove Rhodes Island's position with our actions.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... I hope you can also understand that we can't stand side by side next to someone who looks at us with such a disdainful gaze.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Well said, Cautus. You're a fine leader, but that's not going to change my position. I am responsible for my brothers and sisters in arms too.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Feist... Captain Feist. I'll get going now. Send the word out and have everyone get ready. If you've really thought it through, take these people to the commander.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: She will make the final decision, and whatever her orders are, I will follow them.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Amiya, did I say something wrong? Our relationship didn't break down because of me, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, Closure. Whether or not we are friends is for Mr. Feist to decide.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Come, my Rhodes Island friends. I sure hope my judgment is correct... Otherwise, my lieutenant definitely won't forgive me, and I won't be able to show my face in front of our commander again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Very well, Mr. Feist. We'll follow you. It's a good thing that I want to meet your commander too.
